title: VIXEN build configure requires an implicit Undertow root for Text
body: The queued Release configure via env VIXEN_WITH_FSR3=OFF bash ./build-wsl.sh --target VIXEN -j4 failed at VIXEN/libraries/Text/CMakeLists.txt:5 because UNDERTOW_ROOT was unset, although the VIXEN build and codegen already discover other paired inputs. The recovery is to export UNDERTOW_ROOT=/home/liory/projects/undertow before the same wrapper. Make the paired Undertow root part of the preset or fail with a self-provisioning documented launcher.
